title: 全地图对象/标签重叠与 WASD 移动卡顿只读审计
scope: 37 prologue nodes; read-only; no game source/data modified; temporary probe script removed

method.visual_bbox: Python reads prologue.json + props_data.json; resolves draw kind/aliases exactly like prop_art.gd (props: size+anchor, furniture: near_rect, npc/rong special); decor included; ambient light excluded.
method.solid: Godot headless probe replicates campaign.load_room() + setup_collision() (walls incl. top/bottom/left/right overrides + node walls, decor/object solid_rect, NPC circles) and reports pair overlaps / wall embeddings / spawn & approach checks.
method.movement: Same probe drives combat.step_commands(dir, Vector2.ZERO, [], false) for 180 ticks from each node spawn (60 Hz, speed 80, body radius 5), recording per-tick displacement; 4 WASD directions full arrays in G4-009-engine.json, diagonals summary only.
method.labels: Probe measures label text with the real project TTF (ThemeDB fallback font), reproduces campaign draw_object_labels() clamp (x 8..1272-width, y 116..684) with the longest possible kind suffix.
method.screen: Fixed HUD/status/minimap/dialogue/nameplate rectangles are compared with label rects; HUD/status text widths are Pillow estimates with the project TTF.
method.exclusions: light_pool/ambient overlays, guide beams, guide→guide_target beam crossing, and portal walls are treated as intentional/elsewhere; portal-vs-wall visual overlaps are classified expected_portal.

screen.note: 标签矩形按最长可能后缀计算（worst case）；HUD/status 宽度为 Pillow 读取项目 TTF 的估算，非引擎实测，需人工复核。

excluded.guide_beams: guide 与 guide_target 不参与 bbox 重叠判定；光束/目标点按刻意设计排除
excluded.portal_walls: exit/end 的 portal 视觉与墙体接触按 expected_portal 分类
excluded.wall_mounted_decor: torch/shelf 贴顶墙的少量视觉接触按 wall_mounted 分类

limitations: 视觉包围盒使用 props_data.json 的整件 footprint（家具用 near_rect，含 1px 高亮/粒子边距），不是逐帧 alpha 裁剪；相邻 1~2px 的接触可能被放大。
移动探针只测从出生点沿单方向持续输入的运动；未模拟玩家绕行、斜向组合、敌人/攻击/闪避状态下的移动，也未验证路径连通性（只验证目标附近存在可站立交互点）。
标签文本使用“最长可能后缀”的最坏情况；实际后缀取决于存档状态，实际重叠数量可能更少。
HUD/status 文本宽度为 Pillow 读取同一 TTF 的估算，不是引擎 Label 实测；且 goal/notice 随存档状态变化。
探针为临时文件 game/scripts/_g4_009_probe.gd，运行后已删除；工作区 game/ 无新增残留（见 git status）。
本轮只记录问题，不修复；任何修改需 Lead/策划按 G4 流程处理。
reproduction: 临时放置 game/scripts/_g4_009_probe.gd，运行：godot --headless --path game --script scripts/_g4_009_probe.gd（通过 DSH godot_run_headless，非 shell 启动），产出 qa/evidence/G4/G4-009-engine.json，然后删除探针
